a.xlink:title: Dispatches the next queued command if its time has come.
Routes one command line to the matching handler for the client's type.
Returns the socket descriptor, used to read/write and to poll this client.
Returns the logical id of this client's player, or -1 if it has none.
Returns the connection's current role.
Prints one log line to stdout. Omits the "(...)" group when fields is empty.
Handles the first line of an AI client: the team-name handshake.
Looks up a player by its logical id, or nullptr if none matches.
Returns true while the player is frozen and must not execute any command.

Current tile position.
Builds a passive "pipi" snapshot line (position, orientation, level, inventory) for one player.
Current elevation level (1..8).
Current facing as the protocol's 1..4 orientation (NORTH=1, EAST=2, SOUTH=3, WEST=4).
Free connection slots remaining for a team (used to admit new players).
Map dimensions as (width, height).
Associates this client with the player of the given logical id (set at hatch time).
Sets the connection's role, e.g. once it has been identified or marked dead.
Adds the player pointer to the tile at the given position, if it exists.
Read-only view of all eggs (tile position paired with its egg IDs).
Looks up a team by name, or nullptr if it does not exist.
Removes eggs at a tile (and their slots). With eggID set, removes just that one egg; with count == -1...
Places the player at (x, y), wrapping into the map bounds.
Sets the facing direction.
Returns the tile at the given coordinates.
This player's stable logical id (its GUI player number).
This player's inventory.
Mutable access to the underlying item counts, indexed by ItemType.
Number of free connection slots remaining.
